_comment: Findings whose failure is KNOWN, JUSTIFIED and deliberately carried past the
push guard. This is not a way to push green CI -- CI still runs every gate
and still fails on anything listed here. It only lets the push HAPPEN, with
the failure named on the record instead of routed around silently.
Version 2 carries FINDINGS, not gates. A gate that takes part prints one
`::finding::<key>` line per finding; `npm run ci:quick` records each failed
gate's keys under `findings` in .ci/cache/prepush-receipt.json, and an entry
copies them: {"gate", "findings": [keys], "reason"}. `"findings": "*"`
carries a whole gate, only for a gate that emits no keys yet, and needs a
reason of at least 160 characters.
.claude/rediacc_hooks/guards/block_unverified_push.py reads this file from
HEAD and refuses the push when:
1. a FAILING gate is not carried here;
2. a gate carried here is not failing -- an excuse cannot outlive its failure;
3. a carried gate emitted a key this file does not carry (a NEW finding);
4. a carried key is no longer emitted (a STALE finding: remove it);
5. a keyed gate reported no parsable keys, or a '*' gate does emit keys;
6. an entry is malformed (no version 2, no findings, an empty list, '*'
beside keys for one gate) -- a schema error, never skipped silently.
An entry whose reason is under 80 characters (160 for '*') carries nothing:
the same bar .dead-bash-allowlist applies and test_gate_dead_bash.py proves.
A narrowed run (--only/--skip) is refused before any of this is consulted,
so carrying cannot become a second way to launder a partial lane.

carried.reason: P-A1 is a merge-time condition: every named plan still has open boxes, of two kinds. Live or post-merge runs close only after the push or the merge (edge and stable rollout, the first CD run, scheduled runs on main, hostinger and bench receipts), and implementation boxes are queued in this branch's turbo batch. The operator chose a backup push with no PR (ASKED:2026-10-31T06:05Z), so this push carries no Operational-Reason line; CI still judges every key, and this entry is removed before the merge.

The nightly gate-cost capture runs main (403f47b97 in housekeeping runs 40664390037, 40851451175 and 41035785121), where check:actions failed on docker/login-action v4.6.0 and check:ci-external-links on a bench.rediacc.com 403. This branch already fixes both (login-action v4.7.0 in the workflows; bench.rediacc.com allowlisted in scripts/gates/check-external-links.ts:102), and both gates pass on HEAD. Only the first nightly after the merge can measure them, so the two keys are carried until then; refreshing the baseline now would record a red.
